about_short_description.short_description: WorkClout is a SaaS company that helps manufacturers increase their operational efficiency.

product.name: WorkClout Quality Management System (QMS)
product.description: A cloud-based quality management system designed for manufacturers to digitize and streamline quality processes, inspections, and compliance.

product.name: Custom Form Builder
product.description: A no-code form builder allowing users to create and configure custom inspection and quality forms with over 20 field types and conditional logic.

product.name: Task Management for CAPA Processes
product.description: A task management tool integrated with WorkClout to track, assign, and automate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) within quality workflows.

product.name: Reporting and Analytics
product.description: A reporting module that provides customizable dashboards, PDF exports, and traceability reports to analyze quality data and inspection results.

product.name: Integration and API Services
product.description: Integration capabilities and public APIs that allow WorkClout to connect with external enterprise systems and cloud platforms for data synchronization.
